claim_boundary: Source-only, proposal-only construction of a content-addressed expert candidate batch with exact lineage, parent, frozen-prior-evidence, and finite adaptive-budget receipts. It does not dispatch an agent, call a model or evaluator, train weights, select a winner, promote, deploy, or establish causal business value.

capabilities.name: build_expert_mixture
capabilities.description: Reopen exact expert definitions plus parent and prior-evidence receipts, allocate a bounded deterministic budget, and return canonical proposal-only candidates.

capabilities.name: verify_expert_mixture
capabilities.description: Rebuild the complete batch and reject any field that is not derivable from the bound inputs.

required: two to eight healthy uniquely identified expert definitions
one unique lineage and content-addressed parent receipt per expert
finite plain-integer epoch, minimum, and maximum budgets
preconditions: every descriptor has a reopenable byte preimage with exact SHA-256 and byte count
prior evidence contains exactly one bounded count row per expert
the registry contains at least two distinct healthy lineages
the epoch budget fits between aggregate minimum and aggregate maximum

output_contract.success: A canonical proposal_only_unexecuted candidate batch, adaptive-budget ledger, lineage receipt, source receipt SHA-256, zero execution counts, and all authority false.
output_contract.failure: A typed blocker; no partial candidate batch or authority is returned.
output_contract.verification: A separate verifier rebuilds the whole output from exact inputs and compares canonical bytes.

delta_c.rule: Candidate generation is proposal-only; allocation never dispatches.
Diversity, parent identity, prior evidence, and budget derivation are content-addressed and jointly verified.

out_of_scope: live evaluator execution or score production
fleet rollout or causal value claims

steps: 1. Reopen and hash every expert definition and parent/prior receipt.
2. Normalize expert and evidence order by stable identity.
3. Reject missing, duplicate, unhealthy, or avoidably collapsed lineages.
4. Allocate the exact finite epoch budget with the frozen smoothed-evidence diminishing-return rule.
5. Build candidate, lineage, and budget receipts and seal the canonical batch.
6. Rebuild the entire output before any downstream consumer may cite it.
done_definition: all candidates bind exact expert, lineage, parent, prior evidence, and derived budget
allocated units equal the epoch budget and every allocation remains within bounds
input order cannot change canonical output
all execution counters and authority fields remain zero or false
repair_on_failure: repair the source preimage, identity, lineage, or budget evidence and regenerate a new immutable candidate
never fill missing evidence with zero, infer an authority, or permit the generator to grade itself

exec_block_rules.when: any dispatch, model/evaluator execution, training, promotion, or deployment authority is true
a candidate lineage, parent, source, prior-evidence, or budget field is not exactly derivable
